name: createEcoNewsWithImageTest
description: This test verifies that an authorized user can successfully create a new EcoNews item with image and receive a valid response with generated ID and correct data.
descriptionHtml: This test verifies that an authorized user can successfully create a new EcoNews item with image and receive a valid response with generated ID and correct data.
